mechanism: Cenobamate is a strong CYP3A4 inducer that increases modafinil metabolism, reducing modafinil plasma concentrations and efficacy; modafinil may also induce cenobamate metabolism, potentially reducing anticonvulsant levels.
action: Monitor modafinil efficacy and cenobamate seizure control; consider modafinil dose adjustment upward or alternative wakefulness-promoting agent; monitor for seizure breakthrough if cenobamate levels decrease.
